title: My Temp ban 2 :3

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Hello Zaphiz,

As stated on the punishment guidelines found here, if you have 10 or more infractions within the last 8 months you will be punished for excessive infractions which began on November 14th several weeks before your ban. You have 13 and so your appeal is denied.

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie, Senior Moderator
